item.title: MC1505607: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules to auto-reply with saved templates, automating repetitive responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by late December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow allowing admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out mid-August 2026, it enhances data risk management and compliance without affecting user workflows unless configured by admins.

item.title: MC1492154: Enhanced M365 Copilot Memory - Copilot is now personalized with work data
item.description: M365 Copilot now uses Microsoft 365 data to provide personalized work responses, rolling out worldwide from early October to November 2026. Users can disable this via settings, and admins can control it with enhancedPersonalizationSetting. No admin action or compliance issues are required.

item.title: MC1239927: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams: Bilingual consecutive interpretation mode with Interpreter agent
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Teams introduces a new Consecutive Interpretation mode, enabling structured, turn-by-turn multilingual meetings. Rolling out from May to December 2026, it requires a Copilot license, needs no admin setup, and enhances interactive discussions without changing existing Interpreter features.

item.title: MC1220762: Retirement notice: MDE and XDR Advanced Hunting APIs retiring; migrate to Microsoft Graph Security API
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting APIs by February 1, 2027. Organizations must manually migrate workflows to the Microsoft Graph Security API by January 31, 2027, to ensure continued functionality and improved security integration.

item.title: MC1523090: Microsoft Teams: Initiate side conversations within the meeting chat window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to start or continue private side conversations within the meeting chat window, preserving chat history. This feature rolls out worldwide in January 2027, requires no admin action, and users can disable the side-chat tab if desired. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: RM576279: Power Apps: Model-driven apps - Use row summaries in US Government clouds
item.description: Row summaries are expanding to supported US Government clouds, giving users in regulated environments access to AI-generated insights that help them understand model-driven app records at a glance. This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.

item.title: RM576607: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls
item.description: Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.

item.title: RM577796: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policies on email attachments
item.description: This feature extends governance capabilities to evaluate email attachments, closing a critical gap where sensitive or non-compliant information may exist outside the email body.

item.title: RM577798: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Manage policy strictness to enforce governance policies
item.description: This feature introduces policy strictness control, enabling organizations to define how rigorously each governance policy evaluates and flags potential violations in outgoing emails. Governance policies serve as real-time guardrails, ensuring communications adhere to business, legal, and compliance standards before they are sent to customers.

item.title: MC1523087: Microsoft Teams Mobile: Ask Copilot from Search
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will let users ask Copilot directly from the search box on iOS and Android, with suggestions appearing after typing two words and an Ask Copilot button on search results. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1523086: Alternate text parameter for ODSP attached images in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support adding alt text to OneDrive/SharePoint-hosted images shared in chats, enhancing accessibility with screen reader descriptions. This feature rolls out worldwide from early to mid-December 2026, requires no admin action, and allows users to add or edit alt text without changing the original image files.

item.title: MC1523085: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot metrics will be on by default, and the public preview opt-in setting is being retired
item.description: GitHub Copilot metrics will be enabled by default in the Viva Insights Consumption dashboard starting mid-November 2026, retiring the public preview opt-in setting. Eligible tenants will see these metrics automatically, with existing access controls remaining. No admin action is required, but reviewing access and updating documentation is recommended.

item.title: MC1523084: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Move email messages to quarantine with a new remediation action
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a new "Move to Quarantine" remediation action allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. It rolls out worldwide from November to December 2026, requiring no user action but recommended policy reviews and training updates.

item.title: MC1523077: Teams admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
item.description: AI-powered meeting quality insights in Teams admin center provide proactive detection of issues by analyzing historical data, highlighting hotspots, root causes, and affected users with recommended actions. Rolling out worldwide and GCC from mid-November 2026. No configuration needed; accessible to designated Teams admins.

item.title: MC1523076: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
item.description: Non-channel Microsoft Teams meeting notes, including Loop and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business starting mid-November 2026. This ensures consistent ownership without changing the collaboration experience. No configuration is needed, but update governance processes accordingly. Channel meeting notes storage remains unchanged.

item.title: MC1482800: Teams Phone Agent is rolling out to general availability on Sept 30, 2026
item.description: Teams Phone Agent, an AI-powered calling solution for Microsoft Teams, will be generally available worldwide starting late September 2026. Usage-based billing with Copilot Credits requires admins to configure spending policies and security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center to avoid default auto attendant settings.

item.title: RM578073: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule
item.description: Supervisors can now create and manage overnight shifts that span across midnight while maintaining a single continuous shift experience. Shift plans support start and end times that extend into the next day, allowing organizations to accurately model overnight operations such as contact centers, support teams, healthcare services, and other 24x7 environments.

item.title: RM578072: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Elevate customer experiences - Boost productivity with flexible views and search in segments
item.description: Customize your view: choose a Contact or Lead view from the new view picker to define which columns appear in the segment members table.

item.title: RM578071: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Configure site analytics and server logging
item.description: Gain insights into your Power Pages site with integrated telemetry and analytics. Use Application Insights to monitor page views, form interactions, session details, and client-side analytics. Detect server-side errors, performance issues, and access logs to resolve problems and optimize your site.

item.title: RM578070: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Modify and override submitted evaluations
item.description: This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments.

item.title: RM578069: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: IVR capabilities - Equip voice agents with custom voice
item.description: Secure a voice talent that will represent the voice of your brand. After obtaining explicit consent, gaining Limited Access approval through Microsoft's Responsible AI practices, and building a custom voice model, it's time to integrate with Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

item.title: RM578066: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Digital commerce - Streamline multioutlet access for B2B web storefronts
item.description: The multioutlet B2B web storefront introduces a unified sign-in system that allows buyers to access all their associated organizations and outlets using a single account. The storefront UI is updated to display an organization selector during sign-in and provides outlet-specific navigation and catalog views. Buyers can place, track, and manage orders for multiple outlets within a single session, with real-time visibility into order status, inventory, and account information.

item.title: RM578065: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
item.description: You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules.

item.title: RM578064: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Resolve customer emails autonomously with AI
item.description: Autonomous email resolution delivers end-to-end handling of customer emails without manual intervention or default case creation. When an email arrives, the system analyzes the request, identifies the underlying intent, and determines whether the information and actions needed to resolve it are available.

item.title: RM578063: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Planning - Protect confirmed CTP dates with Planning Optimization
item.description: Planning Optimization is the new high-performance planning engine for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. With this feature, Planning Optimization now protects material and capacity allocated to sales order lines with delivery dates confirmed through capable to promise (CTP). You prevent reallocation of resources to newer orders, so your confirmed delivery dates stay reliable, and customer commitments are honored.

item.title: RM578062: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Manage external authentication providers with granular controls
item.description: Power Pages now lets you manage external authentication providers with environment-level governance controls and optional site-level exceptions. You can centrally enforce which identity providers (IDPs) are allowed across all sites in an environment, while still enabling site-specific flexibility when needed. Makers will only see and select from the approved IDPs when setting up authentication, ensuring consistent governance and alignment with enterprise security policies.

item.title: RM578061: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Omnichannel commerce - Add support for multiple outlet B2B ordering via CSU
item.description: Available for B2B scenarios in Dynamics 365 Commerce (including headless Commerce), this feature enables retailers to configure unified sign-in in Commerce headquarters and integrate third‑party storefronts using CSU APIs. The organization selector and related capabilities are exposed via CSU endpoints so that third-party sites can consume identities, organizational context, and ordering workflows without relying on native UI components.

item.description: As of today, whenever the user wants to enable email notifications the policy tips also need to be enabled and vice versa, but with this decoupling the admin can configure the following: 1) None of policy tips or email notification 2) Only policy tips 3) Only Email Notifications 4) Both Email Notifications and Policy tips

item.title: RM566316: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

item.title: RM577900: Power Pages: Plugin support for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code to create and edit traditional sites
item.description: The Power Pages plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code now supports creating and editing traditional (non-SPA) Power Pages sites. Developers can use natural-language prompts in their AI coding agent to create a new traditional site or download, inspect, and update existing site metadata such as web pages, web templates, content snippets, basic and multistep forms, lists, table permissions, web roles, and site settings, then upload changes back to their environment using the Power Platform...

item.title: RM577878: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Payables Agent - Agent can process vendor credit notes
item.description: Payables Agent can recognize a vendor credit note and produce a purchase credit memo and applies to the original invoice, using the same draft and task experience as invoices. Note: It does not have Return Order matching functionality.

item.title: RM577861: Microsoft Edge: Extended Stable channel support for macOS
item.description: Organizations managing macOS devices will be able to select the Microsoft Edge Extended Stable channel, providing a slower 8-week major release cycle, compared to the two-week major release cycle for Stable.

item.title: RM559482: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
item.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

item.title: RM577401: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator in GCC
item.description: Facilitator is coming to Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC. The Facilitator agent can help capture notes in real time, answers questions about the meeting, and help keep the agenda and discussion on track. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required to use Facilitator.

item.title: RM576285: Power Apps: Expand model access and Maker Studio availability for generative pages via GitHub
item.description: Connect your GitHub account to access additional model options for the built-in gen page coding agent directly in the generative page designer in Maker Studio. Makers can use the agent to create and refine generative pages without leaving the Power Apps authoring experience.

item.title: RM576283: Power Apps: Use Power Platform connectors in generative pages
item.description: Makers can bring data from Power Platform connectors into generative pages. After creating and authenticating a connection and adding a connection reference to the environment, you select the connector data and describe how the generated page should use it. Connector data can be incorporated while working in the Maker Studio generative page designer or through the generative pages AI plugin.

item.title: RM576281: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using speech as input in model-driven apps
item.description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms. Users select the microphone icon, record their content, and the transcript is used as a source for the form entry. Recordings are transient and not saved.

item.title: RM576275: Planner: Custom Views for plans
item.description: Custom views lets users save a custom view of a plan and return to it later without re-applying filters, sorting, grouping, and other view customizations. A team can reuse saved views for triage, prioritization, work tracking, and more.

item.title: RM577399: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
item.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

item.title: RM576609: Microsoft Teams: Default meeting templates
item.description: Default meeting templates enable IT admins to automatically apply their organization’s preferred meeting settings whenever users schedule a Teams meeting through Outlook or Teams calendar. This helps organizations apply meeting settings (including protection settings) at scale, and reduce the need for organizers to manually configure meeting options. Only organizers with a Teams Premium (T-Pre) license assigned can use Default Meeting Templates.

item.title: RM569211: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

item.title: RM569210: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

item.title: RM568368: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
item.description: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

item.title: RM562351: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Get actionable suggestions from Copilot in your Copilot Page
item.description: Request feedback from Copilot on your Page by selecting "Suggested edits" in the Copilot Shortcuts menu. Copilot will analyze the content on your page and provide actionable suggestions about what you can change to improve clarity and quality of your written content. You can then apply suggestions directly to the page. Updated October 23, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM577543: Microsoft Teams: Explicit consent for recording & transcription in one-to-one PSTN calls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support explicit consent for participants connected through the public switched telephone network (PSTN) in one-to-one calls. When explicit consent is required, PSTN participants will hear an audio prompt when recording or transcription is started. They can use their phone keypad to consent or decline. Participants who decline can remain in the call but stay muted. This capability extends the existing Teams calling policy for explicit consent to one-to-one PSTN calls.

item.title: RM488301: Microsoft Teams: Speaker attribution now “On” by default in BYOD rooms with enhanced admin controls
item.description: New PowerShell setting (SpeakerAttributionBYOD in csTeamsAIPolicy), enabled by default, gives IT admins more control over speaker attribution in BYOD (bring your own device) meeting rooms. This enhances the experience for users by enabling clear speaker labels and richer in-meeting and post-meeting insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Users just enroll profiles via Teams Settings to be recognized.

item.title: MC1518030: Updated Photos experience on Windows 11
item.description: Windows 11 will receive an updated Photos app starting mid-October 2026, enhancing browsing, organizing, and viewing local and OneDrive photos. Existing app management and OneDrive policies remain effective. Organizations should review app-blocking rules and inform help desks; no new compliance issues are expected.

item.title: MC1456780: Plan for Change: New device page experience will become the default view
item.description: The new Intune device page will become the default view starting with the September (2609) release, replacing the legacy page. All device management features remain, but admins now need the Managed devices/Update permission plus specific action permissions. Update documentation and review permissions accordingly.

It enables direct publishing of object-centric process mining (OCPM) results into Microsoft Fabric semantic models, making process intelligence data available throughout the Microsoft analytics ecosystem.

item.title: RM577825: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Enable self-service site ownership transfer
item.description: Power Pages now supports secure site ownership transfer for eligible sites. Existing site owners and global administrators can assign ownership to another valid user within the tenant without requiring manual intervention from support.

item.title: RM577824: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Planning - Enhance demand forecasts with multiple data inputs
item.description: Demand planning in Supply Chain Management helps you forecast demand using diverse data sources and signals. The latest updates enhance forecast accuracy, enabling you to optimize your supply chain and improve financial outcomes.

item.title: RM577811: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Elevate customer experiences - Enable advanced personalization using simple formulas to modify text, dates, and numbers

item.title: RM577823: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Manufacturing and asset management - Enforce same-batch selection for raw materials in production and batch orders
item.description: This feature ensures that raw materials consumed by production orders and batch orders all come from the same batch. Process and discrete manufacturers can use it together with related production-control capabilities that govern how raw materials are allocated to a production order.

item.title: RM577814: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data: Agents and Copilot - Increase AI accuracy by grounding agents in customer insights
item.description: The Customer Insights MCP server allows AI agents and chat experiences to access and understand insights generated by Customer Insights - Data.

item.description: Developers often depend on custom JavaScript and fragile Document Object Model (DOM) manipulation to hide fields, update values, or trigger actions, an approach that easily breaks when page structures change, drives up maintenance costs, limits scalability, and leads to inconsistent experiences. Power Pages Client APIs address these challenges by offering stable, documented, and supported methods to interact with components, reducing risk, improving maintainability, and accelerating development.

item.title: RM577819: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - View next best actions with Customer Intent Agent
item.description: An administrator can enable this feature for the entire organization in the Customer Service admin center. Turning on next best actions populates the Copilot pane with actions that service representatives can use. Important case attributes are consolidated in one place as the representative gathers information through back-and-forth exchanges with the customer. Knowledge articles are suggested so representatives can dig deeper and understand the reasoning behind the recommendations.

item.description: Generative insights for Demand planning in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management help you analyze sales history and forecast data across dimensions like product and location.

If you use Microsoft Fabric, Customer Insights - Data makes it easier to share valuable unified profiles and insights directly in OneLake. You can add those insights to your core analytics and downstream processes.

item.description: Power Pages MCP server enables makers to expose site data and operations through a secure, standardized interface compatible with AI clients.

Changes won't take effect until the segments are published, giving marketers control over the timing of the changes. These changes are picked up at the next recurrence for recurring journeys and new additions are applied in real time for ongoing journeys.

item.title: RM576766: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Use time-zone-agnostic fields in project planning
item.description: Project and project task start, and end times are saved in a date-time format. The system converts these times to GMT before saving them. item.title: MC1509803: Microsoft PowerPoint: Publish and unpublish controls for official brand kits
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint will introduce publish and unpublish controls for Official Brand Kits in mid-October 2026, allowing Brand Managers to temporarily remove or restore brand assets without deleting them or changing permissions, enhancing brand content management and availability within organizations. No action is required.

item.title: MC1509801: Microsoft Teams: Customize file extensions blocked by Weaponizable File Protection
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow admins to customize file extensions blocked by Weaponizable File Protection starting November 2026. Organizations can use the default Microsoft list or create a custom list, with the option to revert to the default for automatic updates. User experience remains unchanged. No action required.

item.title: MC1509800: Microsoft Outlook for Android: Multi-select and bulk actions in search results
item.description: Microsoft Outlook for Android will add multi-select and bulk actions in search results starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage multiple emails at once. This feature, already on iOS, improves efficiency without requiring admin action; users should be informed and keep the app updated.

item.title: MC1509799: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal plugins in Word and Cowork
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces legal plugins in Word and Cowork to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline documents using Microsoft 365 context and third-party sources. Rollout occurs from April to December 2026. Admins can enable or disable these plugins; no setup is required.

item.title: MC1509797: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and additional apps ended on October 13, 2026
item.description: Support for Office LTSC 2021 and related apps ended on October 13, 2026, with no more security updates or support. Organizations should upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office LTSC 2024 to maintain security, compliance, and support. Admins must identify and update affected devices promptly.

item.title: MC1509796: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced channel meeting experience
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance channel meetings, allowing scheduling from Teams calendar and Outlook, easier discovery for channel members, and delegate scheduling. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by September 2027 across environments. No admin action needed; informing users is recommended. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1509789: Microsoft Edge: Browser-native XSLT will be disabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Edge will disable browser-native XSLT by default starting mid-December 2026 to reduce security risks. Organizations should identify and migrate affected applications before Edge Stable 159. A temporary XSLTEnabled policy will be available but removed by Edge 176 in Summer 2027.

item.title: MC1509780: Intune ending support for Windows MDM-only enrollment CNAME auto-discovery
item.description: Starting January 15, 2027, Intune will end support for DNS CNAME auto-discovery in Windows MDM-only enrollment. Organizations using this must have users manually enter the Microsoft enrollment server URL. Existing devices and other enrollment methods remain unaffected. Update enrollment procedures accordingly.

item.title: RM573450: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
item.description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. When Facilitator is in your meeting, its Protection skill uses AI to check the meeting transcript for signs of possible social engineering. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

item.title: RM575291: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Full-screen mode on task grid
item.description: Task grid full-screen mode enables project managers and team members to expand the task grid to use the available screen space. By minimizing surrounding page elements, users gain a larger workspace for viewing and managing task hierarchies, schedules, assignments, dependencies, and other task details.

item.title: RM573279: Power Apps: Prompt Columns - multiple lines of text output
item.description: Prompt columns can now store multilple lines of text as prompt output, enabling longer and detailed AI-generated insights to be stored in your tables.

item.title: RM570865: Microsoft Dataverse: Prompt column values in bulk for existing records (backfill)
item.description: Prompt columns can now generate AI values for records that already exist in your table, not just new or updated ones. Makers can choose to apply a prompt to existing records in bulk, optionally filtered to just the rows they need, so historical data gets the same AI-generated insights as incoming data, without touching each record one at a time.
